description: This file defines the OutpostsAccessPointArn class, which models and validates AWS S3 Outposts Access Point ARNs. It provides parsing, accessor methods, and validation specific to this ARN format within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: OutpostsAccessPointArn
classes.description: Represents and handles AWS S3 Outposts access point ARNs, providing parsing, validation, and accessor methods for Outpost ID and Access Point Name.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string into internal data structure, delegating to parent parse and additional processing for Outposts-specific components.

methods.name: getOutpostId
methods.description: Returns the Outpost ID extracted from the ARN.

methods.name: getAccesspointName
methods.description: Returns the access point name extracted from the ARN.

methods.name: parseOutpostData
methods.description: Private static method that splits and extracts components of the resource identifier related to Outposts ARN.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the ARN data for correct service, resource type, and component formats specific to S3 Outposts access points.
